title: AMC 10 Practice: Broken Stick Probability — What Are the Odds?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on geometric probability with a stick broken in two places, solved by mapping the cuts to a point in a triangle. (Level 4 of 5)
Snap a stick in two random places. What are the odds that the longest piece is less than twice the shortest? Turn the two cuts into one dot on a map, find the winning area two ways (a box trick and a walking shortcut), see why each wrong answer is tempting, then try a harder variant yourself.
